description: Replaces .github/dependabot.yml, so one bot owns dependency updates here.
Scoped to github-actions on purpose. The Scala side of this repository is
scala-cli `//> using` directives in frontend/project.scala, which Renovate has
no manager for -- Scala Steward reads them (.github/workflows/scala-steward.yml)
and is left in place. Renovate and Steward therefore do not overlap.
The old Dependabot config carried this note, kept because it is still true:
it keeps the Pages workflow's actions current, and the Node 20 deprecation
warning is exactly what it is here to surface.

packageRules.description: Was the github-actions 'actions' group (patterns: *), weekly, 'ci' commit prefix.
